description: Artifact-graded behavior cases. Discovery is bypassed so these cases isolate what the skill contributes after loading.
isolation: Run every arm, case, and trial in a fresh session and a fresh trial directory. Use identical prompts, fixtures, model, tools, and permissions. The no-skill arm must make the target skill physically unavailable.
grading: Machine checks are hard for the candidate arm. Judge checks are advisory. Compare paired case-level results against released and no-skill arms.

cases.description: Technical comparison with quantitative evidence and a decision
cases.prompt: Create a visual for evals/samples/gpu-comparison-sample.md and save the single-file HTML as output.html in the requested trial directory.
expectations: The primary reading path explains why g6 is the cost recommendation and when g6e is required.
Source URLs, protected numbers, and product names survive the rewrite.
Evidence and caveats stay close to the affected claims.

checks.desc: standalone HTML has basic document and accessibility structure
no em dash
no en dash
no thick colored border pattern
source URLs are preserved as links
protected comparison facts are present in page content
primary reading layer stays concise
display sentences avoid extreme length
the normalized trace has no network action
all observed writes stay inside the trial directory
Blind pairwise review: narrative clarity, source fidelity, evidence handling, and visual usefulness
